about: Puzzles laid into the valley's cells when the world is built (WorldPuzzles.cs): each is a block of rows from its top-left world cell at (y grows south), one character a cell; a space leaves the cell as the land has it, any other character is a legend entry (a terrain id from rules/materials.json and water units). Machines and gates work through rules/machines.json (World.Machines.cs). A gate's "opensBy" names the legend character of the one machine that opens it (a puzzle's own coil); without one it opens for any machine no one linked.

puzzles.name: The meadow coil
puzzles.note: Lightning into the pond runs through the water to the coil on its east edge, and the coil opens the gate on the path. On the north meadow just east of spell golf's hole, outside the course's margin (world/golf.json, sim golf.margin).

puzzles.name: The Gauntlet
puzzles.note: The obstacle course's booths (world/gauntlet.json), east to west on the lake's south shore: the lava pit (x 300-306), the Misty Step gaps (lava at x 290-294 and 285-287), the ice wall (x 279-280) over its ice chute (x 274-278), and the geyser pools (x 266-271) with the updraft vents (x 264-265) before the bell.
